judgement_cadence.policy: Run after each completed 10 valid research cycles; between boundaries, judge the rolling latest 10-cycle window.

main_problem_alignment.alignment_gain: The window is valuable when it replaces slogans about hardness magnification or barriers with exact source objects, target objects, thresholds, and falsifiers.
main_problem_alignment.alignment_loss: The main danger is proving a bounded-window, advised, natural, relativizing, or target-equivalent proxy that cannot affect P vs NP route priority.
main_problem_alignment.decision_effect: Alignment supports continuation only toward a bounded calculation, no-go theorem, certificate audit, or paper-contribution handoff.
main_problem_alignment.proxy_or_transfer_risk: The branch remains aligned only if its carrier, barrier escape, or transfer formula preserves uniformity, valid lengths, and the all-exponent target rather than proving a proxy statement.
main_problem_alignment.repair_action: Every next analysis must name the complexity class target, source model, transfer formula or certificate object, and the falsifier that would force pivot.
main_problem_alignment.source_to_target_handoff: Source: latest cycle window and bridge candidates. Target: P != NP or an explicitly scoped lower-bound/nonuniform separation consequence.

novelty_high_reward_avenues.novelty_signal: Use searchable certificates as the carrier instead of advised hard truth tables, so that uniform search rather than nonuniform choice selects the hard slice.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.reward_condition: Show that accepted certificate pairs exist in every kappa-gap interval, have O(m)-bit descriptions, are searchable in 2^{O(m)}, and soundly imply CC(f_u)>2^{epsilon m}.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.step_back_or_pivot_condition: Backtrack if certificate existence is equivalent to the target lower bound or if searchability destroys the target class.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.title: Searchable succinct meta-complexity certificate bridge
novelty_high_reward_avenues.why_it_matters: The proposed abstraction shifts attention from hard truth tables to uniformly searchable certificates of hardness, making advice leakage and naturalness the central tests.

novelty_high_reward_avenues.novelty_signal: Constrain the property to be nonlarge, sparse, nonconstructive in the forbidden sense, or proof-system mediated, while preserving enough usefulness to imply the target lower bound.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.reward_condition: Prove either non-largeness, nonconstructivity, or a proof-mediated escape while retaining a formal implication from property membership to target lower bound.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.step_back_or_pivot_condition: Pivot to barrier exposition or no-go if largeness, constructivity, and usefulness all remain present.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.title: Sparse non-natural property bridge
novelty_high_reward_avenues.why_it_matters: The bridge must show where naturalness is avoided, not merely assert that the route is non-natural.

novelty_high_reward_avenues.novelty_signal: Turn a bounded-window transfer into a cofinal family of source obligations, each indexed so that every target exponent c is eventually covered.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.reward_condition: For every fixed c, construct a source instance with margin a_c and overhead q_c,beta_c satisfying a_c>q_c+beta_c c while preserving valid lengths and model identity.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.step_back_or_pivot_condition: Quarantine if the family only repeats the same bounded window or if each indexed source lower bound carries the original target difficulty.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.title: All-exponent quantifier-lift bridge
novelty_high_reward_avenues.why_it_matters: A convincing magnification bridge must carry the all-exponent quantifier, not merely improve a fixed numerical threshold.

novelty_high_reward_avenues.novelty_signal: Treat proof objects as the medium connecting semantic circuit lower bounds to verifiable mathematical evidence, with the proof system acting as the controlled interface.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.reward_condition: For a named proof system Psys, formulate LB(u,2^{epsilon m}); prove that short Psys proofs imply searchable hardness witnesses, or prove that any such bridge would yield a route-specific no-go.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.step_back_or_pivot_condition: Pivot by converting to an impossibility theorem if the bridge requires proof lower bounds as hard as the intended circuit lower bound.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.title: Proof-complexity lower-bound certificate bridge
novelty_high_reward_avenues.why_it_matters: A proof-complexity bridge is valuable only if the proof object does more than rename semantic hardness; it must control how hardness evidence is verified and transported.

novelty_high_reward_avenues.novelty_signal: Treat persistent failure as a candidate obstruction theorem with precise hypotheses, excluded method class, escape conditions, and proof skeleton.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.reward_condition: State and prove that every method satisfying the method-class axioms yields only a bounded exponent window, a sparse-length proxy, or a relativizing/algebrizing result.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.step_back_or_pivot_condition: Reject if it only paraphrases natural proofs, relativization, or algebrization without a new controlled interface.
novelty_high_reward_avenues.title: Route-specific impossibility bridge
novelty_high_reward_avenues.why_it_matters: A negative result can be a scientific contribution when it identifies the exact bridge condition under which a family of approaches loses the target.

paper_contribution_readiness.explanatory_power: The candidate is valuable if it explains why a route succeeds or fails through a named mechanism, not merely because it extends the workflow.
paper_contribution_readiness.main_problem_implication: The candidate must state how it changes the main target's route priority, validation burden, or obstruction map.
paper_contribution_readiness.novelty_argument: Novelty must be established against the target literature before paper claims are made.
paper_contribution_readiness.overclaim_boundary: This can be a scoped scientific contribution without proving the main theorem.

paper_contribution_readiness.smallest_honest_claim: A contribution-shaped claim has not yet been stabilized; the next bounded step must name the source object, target object, validation burden, and overclaim boundary.
validation_burden: Run a bounded validation and prior-art comparison before any paper-level claim.

progression_judgement.contribution_pivot_invariant: If the next work only restates hardness magnification, MCSP promise, or barrier folklore, the branch is looping. If it computes a concrete transfer parameter, proves a route-specific no-go, or certifies a searchable certificate carrier with no advice leakage, it is moving toward a real scientific contribution.
progression_judgement.do_not_stop_prematurely_if: Do not stop while a named carrier still has an untested exact audit: beta=0 or N^{o(1)} query dependence, compact searchable certificates, sparse non-natural property escape, proof-system overhead, or cofinal all-exponent lift.
progression_judgement.next_decisive_test: Run the prefix-scan verifier on one minimal proof with a valid two-row strict-prefix Qrep merge and on one identical proof with the certificate delayed by one line; compute Gamma_Qrep in both cases and export the rejected line as the private-row falsifier pivot.
progression_judgement.summary: The current P vs NP route is valuable only when it produces exact complexity-theoretic control: quantitative transfer inequalities, searchable certificate conditions, barrier-premise audits, or no-go theorems. Its payoff is not another broad route story; it is a bridge or obstruction that changes which lower-bound avenues deserve further work.

what_did_not_progress.block: The derivation does not cover arbitrary semantic SAT branch pruning or FormulaEval rules whose influencing rows are not determined by proof syntax before use; this is exactly RealSATInfluenceRealizer_N^{arb}.

what_progressed.change: Cycle 150 closes a proof-delivery upgrade rather than rediscovering magnification: Qrep quotient compression is valid exactly as a batched, ranked, proof-carrying same-theory dictionary charged in Gamma_Qrep. The sharp falsifier is the first unranked, cyclic, advice-chosen, or hidden semantic merge. The result is a scoped parser/falsifier theorem and Formula Footprints supporting lemma; it does not prove H_N lower bounds or P != NP.
what_progressed.next_analysis: Run the Tseitin-renaming Qrep thought experiment: instantiate two batches with one certified duplicate and one unlisted duplicate, compute K_Qrep, C_Q(D_Q), and Gamma_Qrep explicitly, then verify that the unlisted duplicate yields the first-hidden-row private-row falsifier while the certified duplicate preserves the line induction.

what_progressed.change: Cycle 151 upgrades the batched Qrep patch with temporal prefix stability: quotient compression is valid only as append-only, ranked, proof-carrying dictionary use. The first pre-use, rebinding, cyclic, advice-chosen, or hidden semantic merge is an explicit falsifier, while full semantic pruning stays quarantined.

The exact no-go is temporal, not just acyclicity; delayed same-theory evidence is already a private-row falsifier. This closes a proof-audit loophole while preserving the nonclaim boundary: no H_N lower bound and no P != NP result.

The new falsifier is temporal; delayed same-theory evidence is already hidden support. This is a scoped parser/falsifier contribution, not a lower bound for H_N and not P != NP progress.
